variants.subject: Guardian turtle
variants.prompt:
Create one complete full-bleed 1:1 square image, approximately 1536 × 1536.
Background: fill the entire square with solid #b9cddd. Keep it visible in every open area and in the corners not occupied by the character; the assigned emergence corner must be occupied by the character.
Subject: one extremely simplified, cute, endearing Guardian turtle character: navy rounded shell, one broad lime face region, two navy eyes; calm protective personality.
Complexity: use only 4–7 large basic shapes in one soft rounded continuous silhouette and at most two broad internal color regions. Two simple eyes, one tiny mouth only if useful. Remove nonessential lines, anatomical details, texture and decoration. Readable at 32 × 32.
Color behavior: exactly two character base colors #13233a and #dff0a8, plus solid background #b9cddd. Reuse character colors for facial marks. Broad purposeful color masses.
Composition: upright and emerging from lower-left, filling about 85–95% of square. Bottom or assigned-side cropping is welcome. Preserve both paired identifying features. Never center or bottom-center.
Style: lovable baby-like appeal, large soft forms, compact proportions, thick rounded contours, ultra-clean graphic treatment. Add an extremely, extremely subtle, almost imperceptible sense of depth through a barely-there neo-skeuomorphic treatment.
Finish: only character on full-canvas background, normal square outer corners.
Constraints: Use no text or watermark. Add no borders, frames, cards, or presentation masks. Include one character only, with no extra subjects or scenery. Use no fragile lines, sharp tips, unnecessary outlines, tiny details, or decorative marks. Add no photorealistic material, dramatic bevel, glossy hotspot, deep occlusion, extrusion, strong three-dimensional rendering, or external cast shadow. Keep the background solid and uniform, with no texture, vignette, or lighting variation.
